decision_statement: Ship claims-intake 2.3.1 to production on 2026-10-23: build 2.3.1+git.5d1c9f0, SBOM sha256:3b7f…, all 412 tests green, dependency audit clean, migration 0042 reversible.
context_at_decision: Release candidate 2.3.1 fixes the duplicate-attachment defect reported by two brokers (INC-2026-118, INC-2026-121). Change freeze for month-end starts 2026-10-27.
options_considered: Ship 2.3.1 now (chosen): defect fixed, tests green, rollback by redeploying 2.3.0 and reverting migration 0042.
Hold until after month-end freeze: leaves the defect in production for ten more days.
Hotfix 2.3.0.1 with the attachment fix only: smaller change, but migration 0042 would still be needed for the reporting fix brokers asked for in the same window.
assumptions_depended_on: Migration 0042 is reversible within five minutes, as rehearsed on staging.
success_criteria: No duplicate-attachment incident in the seven days after release.

consent_posture.posture_class: not-applicable: no personal data processing changes in this release

affirmation_record.method: signed approval in the release console

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-ISOLUCE-RELEASE-1: the release assistant (release-assistant, version 3) drafted the deploy proposal from CI run 8831 and the dependency audit of 2026-10-23; I reviewed the proposal as shown in the release console view 0412, weighed the three options recorded here, approved the specification whose digest the attachment names, and I am the accountable owner of this decision in my capacity as an employee of iSoluce.

re_decision_trigger: Any duplicate-attachment incident, or a p95 latency rise above 10 %, within seven days.
